messages:
clare: Heads-up: HeliosEdge (HW partner + SI) wants a marketplace public tile and joint announcement in ~4 weeks. They uploaded a SOC excerpt, firmware SBOM (unsigned), and a short security questionnaire. Need quick triage for listing and supply-chain attestations.

toni: quick read: SBOM present but unsigned, no firmware signing proof, questionnaire missing admin MFA and incident notification SLA. These look like listing blockers for public tile.

kevin: i'll own KMS/key custody and pen-test scope asks. mira, can you take firmware signing / SBOM signature?

mira: yes. request they provide signer fingerprint, signing process, and sample verification log (redacted). also ask for evidence of secure boot/root-of-trust.

sec-bot: auto-flag: questionnaire missing admin MFA and telemetry retention; see https://redwood-sec/reports/1819999000-qna

clare: propose compact manifest: 1) SOC excerpt mapped to Redwood controls; 2) signed SBOM or SBOM + signature verification steps; 3) firmware signing attestation (key custody + verification flow); 4) KMS/key policy excerpt or attestation; 5) pen-test summary with CVE listing + remediation dates OR agreement to scoped re-test; 6) IR playbook excerpt + notification contact; 7) telemetry/log retention evidence.

toni: public tile = stricter redaction rules. product-security will do final scrub before publish. partner must redact customer names and live IPs.

kevin: infra note: logging retention baseline = 90 days for marketplace. will paste policy into intake. presign-helper: can create presign links with tag marketplace=heliosedge.

clare: timeline: notify partner today, artifacts due in 6 business days, internal validation 3 business days, redaction 1 business day, final signoff then announce. add contingency to run a 4-hour scoped test if pen report lacks scope.

mira: i've uploaded firmware template to shared drive: https://docs.redwood/hw-attest/heliosedge-template. will DM partner the template.

infra-bot: presign-config: presign expiry default 72h, extension to 7 days available upon request from clare.

clare: sending intake now. will post presign links here when ready. ping if anyone needs escalation. :thumbsup:
